newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank sets next two repos at fixed 3.00 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank sets next two repos at fixed 3.00 pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Thursday that it would keep its main money market rate, the repo, unchanged by setting its next two securities repurchase tenders at a fixed rate of three percent.
Money market dealers had expected the move, which came at the same time the German central bank also kept its discount and Lombard rates unchanged at 2.50 percent and 4.50 percent respectively.
The three percent rate has prevailed since August.
